terms.gloss: get lost, stray from the way

phrases.english: I seem to have lost my way
We wander about, knowing neither the people nor the places

phrases.latin: Sed nec viam dīligenter tenēbam … nec quō locō stabulum esset sciēbam. Itaque quōcumque ieram, eōdem revertēbar
phrases.english: But I wasn’t keeping careful track of the way, … nor did I know where our lodging was. So wherever I went, I kept coming back to the same spot
I think we’re lost: I don’t know where we are.

sources: Lewis & Short: deerro · Lewis & Short: aberro
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 172–173, 217.
